projects.title: A chat room that needs nothing
projects.description: The board makes its own WiFi and everyone in range chats on it. No router, no internet, no account.
projects.after: Join the WiFi devkit-chat and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: A remote for the whole machine
projects.description: Pairs to a laptop as a Bluetooth keyboard and serves the buttons to your phone over WiFi: slides, media keys, typing.
projects.after: Pair devkit-remote from the laptop's Bluetooth settings, then join the WiFi devkit-remote on your phone

projects.title: Tic-tac-toe with a short memory
projects.description: Two phones, rooms by code, the board as referee. Classic, or vanishing: three marks each, the oldest disappears.
projects.after: Join the WiFi devkit-xo and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: Hide the board
projects.description: A hot-and-cold hunt for the board itself: each phone's meter warms as the board hears it louder. Press BOOT to claim it.
projects.after: Move the board to a power bank, then join the WiFi devkit-hide and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: Dots and boxes
projects.description: Two to four players, 4×4, 6×6 or 9×9. Close a box and you go again; the board keeps score.
projects.after: Join the WiFi devkit-boxes and open http://192.168.4.1

projects.title: A mirror that knows the day
projects.description: A smart-mirror screen for any tablet, phone or laptop: clock, weather, air, headlines, on this day. White on black by day, black on white at night.
projects.after: Connect it to your WiFi below, then open http://mirror.local on any screen

projects.title: Drop a file, pick it up
projects.description: Send a file of any size from one device to another through the board, which keeps none of it. Plus shared text notes that clear themselves after a day.
projects.after: Open http://drop.local on both devices (or join devkit-drop if you skip the WiFi step)

projects.title: Ludo
projects.description: The game everyone knows, for 2-4 phones, refereed by the board. Classic or quick, a turn clock, reaction emojis, and a spectator view. Home WiFi or its own network.
projects.after: Open http://ludo.local on each phone (or join devkit-ludo if you skip the WiFi step)

projects.title: A pet that lives on the WiFi
projects.description: A border collie puppy, kitten, bunny, fox kit or panda cub that lives on the board and sits on your computer screen, over any app, wherever you put it, now and then walking off to another computer. Look after it from a phone.
projects.after: Open http://pet.local on your phone to adopt it, then add each computer with the one-line command shown there
